never: touch past the cap or without consent
touch after the item arrived or after a no
offer a discount or a concession to get an answer

provider_block.job: the thing they owe you arrives, and then the chasing stops

checks.title: Every thing owed is an open item with a kind, a record, a person and a due date
The chase order is value at risk, then days open, never age alone
Touches per item are capped and spaced, on a written cadence
A message goes only on a channel the contact has consented to
A follow-up call opens with the AI identification and the recording notice
The call asks for the one thing owed and records the answer as a date or a decision
When the item arrives, the chase stops that run
A no, a dispute, or stop contacting me ends the chase and goes to a person
No touch goes out while the ball is with the business
An item still open at the cap goes to a named person with its history, not into a longer loop
Every touch, its channel, its outcome and the arrival are retrievable by item
